body:
Found in the JH-02 typography review (#105, F2). Parent: #3.

## Problem

Text drawn at 6–8 px through the official renderer shows uneven letter and word spacing. Words visibly split or merge, and the effect differs between macOS and Linux for the same design JSON:

| Element | macOS | Linux (retained render) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| L3 `ribbon_label` (6 px, −12°) | SUNSET SALE | S UN S ETS ALE |
| L3 badge (6 px) | A WARD WINNING 2026 | AWARD WINNING 2026 |
| L3 badge (6 px) | SMALL BATCH | S MALL BATCH |
| L2 `badge_label` (6.67→6 px) | NEWFLAVOR | NEW FLAVOR |
| L2 `cta_label` (8.15→8 px) | SummerLine | Shop  the  Summer  Li ne |

The submission is scored on Linux, where "S UN S ETS ALE" appears. Seven of the eight Level 3 texts are drawn at the 6 px floor, so most of that output is affected.

## Likely cause (not isolated)

This fits the RF-01 notes: upstream draws at `int(font_size)`, positions glyphs by advance only (no kerning), and wraps at the float size. At these sizes, per-glyph rounding seems to open or close gaps. This needs confirming, for example by rendering the same string at 6, 7 and 8 px on Linux, before choosing a fix such as raising the floor for these labels or changing what the engine asks the renderer to draw.

## Evidence

- [L3 labels](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/evidence/jh-02/png/l3_labels_4x.png)
- [L2 badge](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/evidence/jh-02/png/l2_badge_4x.png)
- [L2 CTA](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/evidence/jh-02/png/l2_cta_4x.png)
- [review](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/evaluation/typography/2026-10-08-official-samples.md)

Linux images are the channels' retained renders for the same design hashes, unchanged on main `8ac29a0`.

## Suggested acceptance

- On Linux, the public-sample labels render with word gaps present and no gaps inside words, at 1× and 2× (human check), with a reproducible render.
- If a size floor or another engine change is the fix, a control shows the Level 3 output before and after on Linux.

comments.body:
Bounded Linux/macOS spacing diagnosis is now published on main `b7e8eab86df265580fa3ffab9ccda335ee8f6ef3`. [Exact evidence](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/b7e8eab86df265580fa3ffab9ccda335ee8f6ef3/docs/evidence/2026-10-15-linux-spacing/README.md).

The pinned diagnostic compares 50 matched input/font/renderer rows and 20 fractional/integer controls. Default advances were integer-valued on Linux and fractional on macOS; diagnostic linear/unhinted metrics nearly matched across platforms, while a subpixel-only change did not resolve the difference. These measurements narrow the investigation; they do not prove readable word spacing or an accepted engine-side workaround. The actual official renderer and font floor were not changed.

#148 stays OPEN: a causal safe workaround and the original real-human Linux1x/2x spacing verdict remain outstanding. Do not infer a visual pass from metric agreement or the passing diagnostic tests. Next trigger: exact reviewed workaround/renderer constraint answer and actual Linux before/after human assessment.

title: [Typography] Letter and word spacing breaks at 6–8 px in rendered output
